notes: Catalysis paper (D-glucose hydrogenation over Ru on carbon microfibers). The only measured H2 uptake is pulse H2 chemisorption on a ChemBET Pulsa (H2 pulses into a carrier gas through the catalyst bed, unadsorbed H2 by TCD; main p. 2, Section 2.3), read here as a flow method under I1; if that reading is rejected, I1 fails and the code is still no_conditions_stated. Sorbents RuCMF/RuCMFN contain 6.4/6.3 wt% Ru (Table 1), so carbon is the majority component (metal-decorated carbon). The 8 MPa, 100 °C condition (Section 2.4) is the liquid-phase glucose hydrogenation reaction, not a measured H2 uptake. Uptake values are given only in µmol g−1 at 'room temperature' with no pressure, so I3 fails.
